cards.name: agent-decision-receipts
cards.description: Mint a tamper-evident, post-quantum-signed receipt for a consequential agent action (deploy, delete, pay, grant-access, model decision) so it can be verified later from the certificate alone. Use when an autonomous agent takes a side-effecting action that may need to be proven later, or when satisfying EU AI Act Article 12 record-keeping. Three decisions: whether an action needs a receipt, minting it, verifying it. Signing is delegated to the open-source OpenAgentOntology package. Not after-the-fact log analysis; not a hosted notary; not a legal opinion.

headings: Install the open-source receipt primitive (Apache-2.0). Add [pq] for the post-quantum legs.
1. Build + validate an action manifest (stdlib only, no crypto, no network)
2. Mint the receipt over it (Ed25519 + post-quantum legs)
3. Verify from the cert alone (no DB, no network)
-> {'ok': True, 'sig_ok': True, ... 'reason': 'verified from the cert alone via: ed25519, ml_dsa, slh_dsa'}
